releaseNotes: v1.9.7: Subdivision plan print and Full / Partial orders. Crop the plan to its frame; mark lots Saleable, Non-saleable, Road or Open Space; road lots are tagged Road completed and Drainage completed; Status of Construction prints on a full A4 page with a legend; continuances and resumptions can be Full or Partial, named "Partial Work Suspension Order No. 1" and "1st Continuance of ..."; the Project Profile lists orders with days, dates, amount and reason.
